gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosed with glioblastoma through histopathological examination;

candidate_evidence.quote: WL276 CAR-T cells: This study intends to include 6 subjects, with 3 subjects receiving 5 \* 10 \^ 6 CAR-T Cells and 3 subjects receiving 1 \* 10 \^ 7 CAR-T Cells at different doses

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients with unresectable recurrent or progressive glioblastoma who have failed or are intolerant to standard treatment;

role_evidence.quote: WL276 CAR-T Cell Therapy for CD276 Positive Recurrent or Progressive Glioblastoma Patients

agents.drug_class_hint: CD276 (B7-H3)-directed CAR-T cell therapy (WL276), intracranial via Ommaya
arms: CD276 positive recurrent or progressive glioblastoma

source_quote.quote: have positive CD276 expression detected by immunohistochemistry;

coder_notes: Early Phase 1 CAR-T trial; only intervention is a cell therapy (excluded type). CD276 IHC positivity is an entry requirement and is target-matched to the CAR-T, but the CAR-T is not a candidate, so candidate_matched=false. CAR-T retention in CSF/tumour tissue and cytokine changes are planned (otherOutcomes) but relate to a non-candidate, so tumour_pk_planned and target_engagement_planned coded no.
